purpose: Test whether the source-backed whole-waveform natural-cubic NQC route converges under two further decades of ODE tolerance refinement, retaining the frozen 0.5 M output chart and independent Torch/JAX initial solves.
interpretation: An ODE-tolerance self-convergence gate on a fixed output chart. It does not validate output cadence, source or NR fidelity, gradients, parameter-domain coverage, or ROM training. Solver failure or nonconvergence fails this gate.
